A_lattice_and_Ward.divisibility_obstruction: No lattice isomorphism U:Lc->Ls can obey U(q)=2r for an Ls root r: 2-divisibility is preserved, but q/2 is not in Lc while r is in Ls.

analytic_interval_criterion.scope: all real 0<alpha<1; this is the analytic step, not a conclusion from the finite root census
analytic_interval_criterion.integer_coset: Each coordinate has |delta_k|<1/2, so the unique unconstrained integer minimum is zero; it lies in D8.
analytic_interval_criterion.half_coset_Ls: The coordinatewise half-integer minimum is p*=(+1/2)^4,(-1/2)^4, has even parity, and energy zero.
analytic_interval_criterion.half_coset_Lc: Odd parity requires an odd change of integer offsets. Coordinatewise convexity makes the cheapest parity-changing move a sign flip of one +/-1/2 entry; outward moves to +/-3/2 cost more. The two cheapest sign flips cost delta_4=alpha/8 and -delta_3=(1-alpha)/8; all other flips cost more.
analytic_interval_criterion.conclusion: Full-lattice ground multiplicities are Ls=2 and Lc=1. The Lc half-coset minimum is min(alpha,1-alpha)/8, with two minimizing roots only at alpha=1/2.

B_time_energy.finite_census_limitation: The displayed root-plus-zero tables alone do not prove the infinite-lattice minimum.

D_two_mode_Fock.scope: Adding an ordinary fermion mode gives the graded tensor Fock factor and flips ordinary fermion parity; it does not by itself construct a spinor lattice extension.

nonclaims: No total no-go for all identifications or extensions.
No P1/P2 solution or physical state-selection derivation.
No claim that the particular pullback projector is the full 2L double-cover space.
No derivation of the c-chiral extension from the unchanged CAR source.
